build_compute_inputs_and_labels: compute inputs and labels from a dict containing observation and target sequences
create_chunks_generator: create a generator that yields Chunk objects from enumerated sequences using masking rules
run_get_chunks_from_dataset: run batched chunk generation from a dataset iterator with optional multithreading
test_pad_to_multiple: test padding a numpy array to a multiple of a given sequence length
summarize_compute_token_types: summarize computing token types for inputs and labels using token type ranges
